# Sitrep

> Open-source, self-hostable global situation-awareness console. Merges free
> public feeds (GDELT, USGS, NASA EONET, GDACS, international RSS, markets)
> into a map, wire, convergence hotspots, tension index and AI situation
> briefs. AGPL-3.0.

## For agents — start here

- [Agent guide](docs/ai/agent-guide.md) — how to consume Sitrep: endpoints, tool names, degradation rules
- [API contracts](docs/ai/api-contracts.md) — normative field-level schemas, envelope, error shapes
- [MCP server](docs/ai/mcp.md) — `/mcp` tools: sitrep_events, sitrep_news, sitrep_earthquakes, sitrep_hotspots, sitrep_signals, sitrep_markets, sitrep_brief
- [OpenAPI 3.1 spec](src/lib/openapi-spec.ts) — served live at `/api/v1/openapi.json`
